viewing_check: Estimate 30-60 for five pieces. The lamp is the value item: Capodimonte-style lamps sell A$60-205 on eBay AU, so lamp alone is about A$60-120 depending on whether it is marked (look for a crowned N mark underneath) and works (check wiring/safety, plug looks old). Jar about A$70, ewer and figurines low value. Check for chips to the encrusted flowers (commonly damaged). Prices stable, mostly 2024-2026.
